text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where champions of each 
generation gather. In terms of sheer 
ability, Mejiro Ramonu surely wouldn't 
fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If there is any concern, it's her lack of 
racing experience at 2,500m... Yet, Mejiro 
Ramonu feels not a trace of anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opponents and aptitudes matter not. Even 
at the Dream Grand Prix, she will simply 
stay true to her own love—
